country_data.historical_yield_reference_source: FAOSTAT tomato yield series, reproduced by Geo Factbook for Botswana; 2024 value
country_data.historical_yield_reference_note: National historical yield reference only; retained as evidence metadata and not substituted for the calculator's scenario yields. Local production costs and current farmgate selling prices remain unverified.
country_data.recent_market_listing_reference_source: Mpatlise Horticultural Market Commercial Association Portal; Francistown tomato listing explicitly stated P15.00 per kg, posted 24 September 2026
country_data.recent_market_listing_reference_note: Farmer-market listing snapshot, not an official national farmgate price series. A separate 28 July 2026 listing reported P18/kg. These observations are retained as market evidence only and are not used as the calculator selling-price assumption; current representative prices and full production costs remain unverified.
country_data.lea_enterprise_budget_reference: Five Botswana open-field tomato farmer budgets across Kgatleng, Ngami, Boteti, North East and Chobe districts; separate Central District shade-net case excluded from the comparable ranges
country_data.lea_enterprise_budget_reference_source: Local Enterprise Authority, Tomato Enterprise Budgets, March 2024; farmer-record-based open-field cases in Kgatleng, Ngami, Boteti, North East and Chobe districts
country_data.lea_enterprise_budget_reference_note: Historical farmer-record enterprise budgets, not a current national average. Comparable open-field cases reported yields of 8.25–22.8 t/ha, farmgate prices of BWP10–15/kg and reported enterprise cost totals of BWP33,841–133,880/ha. The report notes farmer-to-farmer variation, possible cost allocation/omission errors and excludes some overheads. A separate Central District shade-net case used crates and is not included in these ranges. Retained as reference evidence only; not used to set calculator scenario inputs.
country_data.government_vegetable_guideline_budget_re: Botswana Government Vegetable Enterprise Guideline, tomato open-field one-hectare illustrative budget
legacy guide hosted 2019-12; original publication date not stated
country_data.government_vegetable_guideline_source: Government of Botswana, Vegetable Enterprise Guideline, tomato crop budget for one hectare
country_data.government_vegetable_guideline_note: Legacy illustrative government budget, not a current quote or observed national average. The table reports 30 tonnes, BWP12/kg, BWP12,320 production costs and BWP12,940 marketing costs (BWP25,260 total variable costs); the printed break-even price is BWP0.84/kg. The guide itself says crop budgets are guides only and should be adjusted for price movements, season and farm characteristics. Fixed assets and some overheads are separate/not fully included. Kept as evidence metadata only; not substituted for current calculator scenarios.
country_data.ministry_vegetable_manual_reference: Botswana Ministry of Agriculture, Manual for Vegetable Production (first published 2003; reprinted 2006), tomato cultivar and production guidance
country_data.ministry_tomato_cultivar_yield_reference: Moneymaker 62 t/ha; Expresso 65 t/ha; Heinz 1370 60 t/ha; Zeal 66 t/ha; Zest 75 t/ha; Sixpack 60 t/ha
country_data.ministry_tomato_first_harvest_days_after: 80–90 days for the named cultivars; some September–January plantings reported at 60–70 days
country_data.ministry_tomato_irrigation_interval_days: 1.5 days in summer; 4 days in cool/winter season
country_data.ministry_vegetable_manual_source: Government of Botswana, Ministry of Agriculture, Department of Agricultural Research, Manual for Vegetable Production in Botswana, first published May 2003 and reprinted 2006
country_data.ministry_vegetable_manual_note: Historical cultivar-potential and husbandry references from a Botswana government horticultural manual. The 60–75 t/ha figures are named-cultivar mean/potential yields, not observed current national farm averages; irrigation and maturity guidance are legacy technical recommendations. These figures are not used as calculator scenario yields, prices or costs.
country_data.lea_kgatleng_open_field_case_source: Local Enterprise Authority, Tomato Enterprise Budgets, March 2024; Kgatleng District (Malotwana), one-hectare open-field farmer-record case, three-month cropping period
country_data.lea_kgatleng_open_field_case_note: A single farmer-record example, not a national average or current quote. Reported yield 22.5 t/ha, farmgate price BWP12/kg, revenue BWP270,000/ha and total variable costs BWP68,121/ha (including harvest/distribution and other variable costs); gross margin BWP201,879/ha. The report excludes farm-level overheads and warns that farmer cost allocation and omissions may distort results. This case is retained as a local observed budget reference, not a calculator scenario by itself.
country_data.government_vegetable_guideline_tomato_ar: Rechecked against the Government PDF on 2026-11-06. The legacy tomato table states 30 tonnes, 4,200 x 7 kg, BWP12/kg, revenue BWP50,400, production costs BWP12,320, marketing costs BWP12,940, total variable costs BWP25,260 and gross margin BWP25,140. The printed revenue does not reconcile with 4,200 x 7 kg at BWP12/kg (which would be BWP352,800), nor with 30 tonnes at BWP12/kg (BWP360,000). The printed gross margin reconciles to the printed BWP50,400 revenue less BWP25,260 costs. Treat this legacy table's revenue/yield arithmetic as internally inconsistent; do not use its tomato price/revenue/yield values to calibrate calculator scenarios. The separate 30-tonne yield guidance in the maturity table is also historical and not a current observed farm yield.
country_data.source: Local Enterprise Authority, Tomato Enterprise Budgets, March 2024; Kgatleng District (Malotwana), one-hectare open-field farmer budget and its published ±30% sensitivity analysis
country_data.cost_source: LEA Kgatleng open-field tomato enterprise budget: total variable costs BWP68,121/ha, with seven published cost categories. Excludes farm overheads and fixed costs.
country_data.yield_source: LEA Kgatleng farmer-record case: actual yield 22.5 t/ha; published sensitivity analysis tests output at -30% and +30%, giving 15.75 and 29.25 t/ha. Scenario bounds are modelled sensitivities, not national yield percentiles.
country_data.price_source: LEA Kgatleng farmer-record case: farmgate price BWP12/kg; published sensitivity analysis tests selling price at -30% and +30%, giving BWP8.40 and BWP15.60/kg. Scenario bounds are modelled sensitivities, not observed market minimum/maximum.
country_data.cost_breakdown_source: LEA Kgatleng District (Malotwana), one-hectare open-field budget. Planting material BWP10,200; fertilizers BWP9,066; agrochemicals BWP18,840; labour BWP6,000; other pre-harvest BWP1,400; harvest/distribution BWP20,740; other variable costs BWP1,875; total BWP68,121/ha.
country_data.scenario_method_note: The calculator's low/expected/high yield and selling-price inputs are built from the LEA report's explicit -30% / actual / +30% sensitivity cases around 22.5 t/ha and BWP12/kg. The per-hectare cost and breakdown use the same observed Kgatleng budget baseline (BWP68,121/ha). The report is historical (March 2024), based on a single district farmer case for these baseline inputs, and excludes farm overheads; use as a transparent Botswana-specific planning estimate, not a current guaranteed quote or national average.
country_data.recent_market_check_reference: A current Mpatlise supplier stall page lists a Francistown supplier's tomato offer at BWP15/kg; this is a supplier asking price, not a verified transaction or national farmgate average.
